def toggle_middle_bits(n: int) -> int:
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    # Find the position of the most significant bit
    bit_length = n.bit_length()
    if bit_length <= 2:
        return n  # No middle bits to toggle
    # Create a mask with 1s in all middle bit positions
    mask = (1 << (bit_length - 1)) - 1  # bits below the highest bit
    mask &= ~1  # clear the lowest bit
    return n ^ mask

# Example test
if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert toggle_middle_bits(9) == 15
    print("Test passed")
